conceptual_checks.details: Every package declares and contains README.md, manifest.json, contract.json, acceptance.json, and traceability.json; examples are consistently absent.
Feature identifiers are unique and catalog order matches the six-entry authoritative inventory.
Every manifest dependency set equals its contract dependency set; the domain catalog dependencies equal their union.
All public error codes are preserved from finalized artefacts; no local code was invented.
No algorithm step list was copied as a mandatory total order. All operations use justified partial constraints.
All routed unresolved identifiers, reservations, unavailable-oracle status, and acceptance-rule markers remain explicit.

Manual review against the published schemas found and corrected MESSAGE-006 collection.kind from unsupported record to supported set. Other collection kinds, statuses, error formats, acceptance categories, and traceability shapes were reviewed as schema-valid.
No C++, Python, pseudocode implementation, or language-specific normative code was added.
Writes are limited to Message feature packages, Message domain catalog, and Message handoff reports.

known_infrastructure_issue.statement: registry/domain-finalization/message/feature-status.yaml contains the correct six ordered feature entries but lacks feature_count or population_count, while tools/handoff/validate_handoff.py requires at least one of those fields before validating feature packages.
known_infrastructure_issue.allowed_scope_response: The discrepancy is documented. The task expressly forbids modifying the protected inventory or validator, so no in-scope correction or validator bypass exists.
